series.title: Search in the Deck
series.sub: Apps, contacts, sums and the web, as you type

steps.title: Open the Deck, tap Search
steps.text: Swipe in from the tab, then tap Search. The keyboard comes up, ready for you to type.

steps.title: Work out a sum
steps.text: Type a sum and the answer appears as you type. Tap Copy result to copy it.

steps.title: Find an app
steps.text: Type part of an app’s name and it shows up. One tap opens it.

steps.title: Find a contact
steps.text: Your quick-dial people show up too, ready to call or message.

steps.title: Call a number
steps.text: Type a phone number and one tap opens the dialer with it.

steps.title: Search the web
steps.text: Anything else goes to the web. Pick a provider, or press Search on the keyboard for your default.

steps.title: Close it
steps.text: Tap anywhere outside, or press Back. The Deck slides away and the tab comes back.
